crossRefs.note: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
“But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep…
These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house…
I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she…
But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying…
“But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way…
For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?
What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by…
For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing…
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful…
The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into…
All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this…
All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have…
We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of…
How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?
Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.
translations.bsb: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands she received no help. Her enemies looked upon her, laughing at her downfall.
translations.kjv: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
translations.asv: Jerusalem remembereth in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old: When her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and none did help her, The adversaries saw her, they did mock at her desolations.
